fields.name: Fractal Design Define 7 White
fields.description: The Fractal Design Define 7 White is a spacious, quiet ATX mid-tower case designed for excellent noise reduction, flexible component layouts, and efficient cooling. Its clean design makes it suitable for both professional workstations and high-performance desktop PCs.

fields.cooling_system: 2x 140 mm fans included; supports additional 120 mm and 140 mm fans

fields.name: NZXT H510i Black
fields.description: The NZXT H510i Black is a compact mid-tower case with a minimalist design, tempered glass side panel, and integrated smart features. It is designed for clean-looking gaming builds and straightforward cable management.

fields.front_panel_ports: 1x USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-C, 1x USB 3.0, HD audio
fields.cooling_system: 1x 120 mm fan included; supports additional 120 mm and 140 mm fans

fields.name: be quiet! Dark Base 900 White
fields.description: The be quiet! Dark Base 900 White is a spacious full-tower case designed for quiet operation and highly configurable system builds. Its modular interior provides flexibility for powerful gaming PCs, workstations, and custom cooling configurations.

fields.cooling_system: 3x 140 mm fans included; supports additional 120 mm, 140 mm, and 200 mm fans

fields.name: Lian Li O11 Dynamic Mini White
fields.description: The Lian Li O11 Dynamic Mini White is a compact dual-chamber case with a distinctive glass-panel design and flexible hardware compatibility. It is ideal for showcase builds where component visibility and organized cable management are priorities.

fields.cooling_system: 2x 120 mm fans included; supports additional fans and radiators depending on configuration

fields.name: Corsair iCUE 4000X RGB White
fields.description: The Corsair iCUE 4000X RGB White is a stylish mid-tower case featuring a tempered glass side panel and a front panel designed to showcase its RGB lighting. It combines an attractive appearance with flexible cooling options for gaming systems.

fields.front_panel_ports: 1x USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-C, 1x USB 3.0, HD audio
fields.cooling_system: 3x 120 mm SP RGB ELITE fans included; supports additional fans and radiators

fields.name: Fractal Design Meshify C Black
fields.description: The Fractal Design Meshify C Black is a compact mid-tower case featuring a distinctive mesh front panel for efficient airflow. Its space-efficient interior supports a wide range of gaming components while maintaining a clean, understated appearance.

fields.cooling_system: 2x 120 mm fans included; supports additional 120 mm and 140 mm fans

fields.name: Cooler Master MasterBox MB530P RGB White
fields.description: The Cooler Master MasterBox MB530P RGB White is a mid-tower case with a striking white finish, tempered glass panels, and RGB lighting. Its cooling-focused design offers a practical foundation for an attractive gaming PC.

fields.cooling_system: 3x RGB fans included; supports additional fans and radiators

fields.name: ASUS ROG Strix Helios White
fields.description: The ASUS ROG Strix Helios White is a premium full-tower gaming case with a bold design, tempered glass panels, and extensive cooling support. Its spacious interior is designed for high-performance hardware and elaborate custom builds.

fields.front_panel_ports: 1x USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-C, 4x USB 3.1 Gen 1 Type-A, HD audio
fields.cooling_system: 3x 140 mm fans included; supports additional fans and radiators

fields.name: NZXT H1 Mini White
fields.description: The NZXT H1 Mini White is a compact Mini-ITX case with a vertical layout designed to save desk space. Its integrated cooling and power-supply configuration makes it a convenient foundation for a compact gaming PC.

fields.front_panel_ports: 1x USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-C, 1x USB 3.0, HD audio
fields.cooling_system: Integrated liquid cooling system; cooling configuration depends on the H1 revision

fields.name: Fractal Design Define 7 Compact White
fields.description: The Fractal Design Define 7 Compact White is a compact case designed for quiet operation and a clean, minimalist appearance. Its adaptable interior and sound-dampening design make it suitable for both workstations and everyday desktop systems.

fields.front_panel_ports: 2x USB 3.0 Type-A, 1x USB Type-C, HD audio
fields.cooling_system: 2x 120 mm fans included; supports additional 120 mm and 140 mm fans
